approvalTitle: Implementation Tasks for Workflow Node-to-Code Conversion
content:
# Tasks: Workflow Node Conversion Engine

- [ ] 1. Define Workflow AST interfaces in src/CodeComponents/CodeGenerator.ts <!-- id: 1 -->
  - File: e:/Project/VSCodeExtensions/VSCodeClassDiagram/src/CodeComponents/CodeGenerator.ts
  - Implement `WorkflowAst`, `WfAstNode`, `IIfNode`, `IWhileNode`, `IActionNode`, etc., as designed.
  - Purpose: Formalize the intermediate data structure for workflow logic.
  - _Requirements: 1_
  - _Prompt: Role: TypeScript Architect | Task: Define Workflow AST interfaces in CodeGenerator.ts following the design in design.md. Ensure all node types (If, While, Action, Return, Sequence) are covered. | Success: Interfaces are defined and exported correctly. No syntax errors._

- [ ] 2. Expand IGeneratorBuilder and CodeBuilder in CodeGenerator.ts <!-- id: 2 -->
  - File: e:/Project/VSCodeExtensions/VSCodeClassDiagram/src/CodeComponents/CodeGenerator.ts
  - Add `generateWorkflow(ast: WorkflowAst): string[]` to `IGeneratorBuilder`.
  - Add `protected` helper methods to `CodeBuilder` to handle recursive AST traversal.
  - Purpose: Update the generator interface to support workflow conversion.
  - _Requirements: 2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Update IGeneratorBuilder interface and CodeBuilder abstract class to include workflow generation methods. Implement a recursive dispatcher for WfAstNode types. | Success: Methods are added and CodeBuilder provides a base implementation for traversal._

- [ ] 3. Implement Workflow generation in TypeScriptBuilder <!-- id: 3 -->
  - File: e:/Project/VSCodeExtensions/VSCodeClassDiagram/src/CodeComponents/TypeScriptBuilder.ts
  - Implement language-specific node generation (e.g., `if (cond) { ... }`, `while (cond) { ... }`).
  - Purpose: Enable workflow-to-code conversion for TypeScript.
  - _Requirements: 2, 3_
  - _Prompt: Role: TypeScript Specialist | Task: Implement `generateWorkflow` in TypeScriptBuilder. Ensure proper indentation and use of curly braces. | Success: TypeScript code is generated correctly from WorkflowAst._

- [ ] 4. Implement Workflow generation in RustBuilder <!-- id: 4 -->
  - File: e:/Project/VSCodeExtensions/VSCodeClassDiagram/src/CodeComponents/RustBuilder.ts
  - Implement language-specific node generation for Rust (e.g., `if cond { ... }`, `while cond { ... }`).
  - Purpose: Enable workflow-to-code conversion for Rust.
  - _Requirements: 2, 3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Rust Developer | Task: Implement `generateWorkflow` in RustBuilder following Rust idioms (no parentheses in conditions, proper indentation). | Success: Rust code is generated correctly from WorkflowAst._

- [ ] 5. Update CodeGenerator.generate logic <!-- id: 5 -->
  - File: e:/Project/VSCodeExtensions/VSCodeClassDiagram/src/CodeComponents/CodeGenerator.ts
  - Update the main generation loop to leverage the new workflow conversion when an operation has an associated workflow.
  - Purpose: Integrate workflow conversion into the main build process.
  - _Requirements: All_
  - _Prompt: Role: System Integrator | Task: Update CodeGenerator.generate to check for workflow data in IOperationModel and call generateWorkflow. | Success: Operations with workflows generate the corresponding logic inside their method bodies._
